run_felzenszwalb_segmentation: run the Felzenszwalb segmentation algorithm on an image with configurable scale and min_size parameters
create_fh_masks_for_imagenet: create Felzenszwalb segmentation masks for all ImageNet images using multiprocessing and save as numpy arrays
process_single_image_segmentation: process a single image by computing Felzenszwalb segmentation and saving the result as an npy file
get_imagenet_image_files: get a list of all image file paths from an ImageNet ImageFolder dataset directory
compute_multi_scale_segmentation: compute Felzenszwalb segmentations at multiple scales and min sizes and stack results into a numpy array
